non_comparable_note: 2000-2002 are not comparable with later years: the record starts in November 2000, 2001 was reprocessed Terra-only (about a third of the 2003 Terra level), and Aqua joins in July 2002. Their counts and maps are published; z and ratio are withheld.

constellation.note: MODIS is Terra + Aqua merged. The record starts with Terra in November 2000; Aqua contributes from July 2002. 2000-2002 are therefore not comparable with later years and carry no z or ratio.
